run_agent_conversation: run an AI agent conversation with tool calling capabilities using a specified model and API endpoint
create_agent_with_tools: create an AIAgent instance configured with specific model, base URL, API key, and enabled toolsets
switch_agent_model: switch the AIAgent model and provider in-place for a live running session without restarting
interrupt_agent_execution: interrupt an AIAgent's current tool-calling loop from another thread to gracefully stop and process a new message
summarize_agent_iteration_budget: summarize the iteration budget status showing used, remaining, and max total iterations for an agent session
